input.quote: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Client is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system, design, formula, procedure or trade secret to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink hereunder
input.rationale: No covenant anywhere in the Agreement restricts the businesses Client may operate or the products it may buy or build. Section 2(a) does the opposite: it expressly confirms Client is not obligated to use the License and is free to acquire, develop or license competing software and services, subject only to non-infringement of TrueLink IP and Section 10 confidentiality (p0024) — both standard IP/confidentiality protections rather than field-of-use or non-compete restraints. Section 8 (Covenants and Warranties of Client) contains only compliance, non-representation, access-control, anti-spam and Client Content warranties; the "Non-Competition Agreement" referred to in Section 8(d) operates as a limitation on TrueLink's licence to use Credit Data, i.e. in our favour. The requirement in Section 3(i) that Client order a credit report for each underwriting approval requested "through a System using the Interface" (p0042) applies only when Client voluntarily uses the Interface and sits alongside Client's express freedom to use alternatives, so it is a sourcing mechanic, not exclusivity or a non-compete. The licence grant's description of Client's ordinary-course consumer-finance business defines the scope of TrueLink's own grant rather than restraining Client's activities. This meets the preferred position, so no redline is proposed.
